newsitem.title: USA: Penederm gets FDA ok for antifungal cream.
newsitem.headline: Penederm gets FDA ok for antifungal cream.

text.p: Penederm Inc said Thursday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has given marketing clearance to Mentax, its antifungal cream.
The cream is one percent butenafine hydrochloride cream that will be marketed in the U.S. and co-promoted by Schering-Plough HealthCare Products Inc, Penederm said.
Penederm said Kaken Pharmaceutical Co Ltd developed Mentax formulations and the drug has become one of the leading topical antifungals in Japan.
Penederm said it has exclusive rights to the active compound in Mentax in North, Central and South America for use against skin and nail fungus.
It said it is evaluating Mentax in Phase II clinical trials with Schering-Plough HealthCare Products for treating nail fungus and is developing future Mentax antifungal products.
